title: Let customers remove cancelled orders from their history
description: Customers asked to tidy their order history. Adds DELETE /api/orders/:id for one of the customer's own cancelled orders; pending and paid orders stay. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The route answers 409 rather than throwing, so the `catch` never runs and the test makes no assertion at all: it would pass if paid orders could be removed. Assert the 409 status and that the order still exists.
